description:
~50 fixtures carry decorative budget keys and GOLDEN.md documents enforcement that does not exist.

fixtures2/GOLDEN.md:38 claims budgets are 'checked by fz dump --emit stats against a
+/-20% band'. Both halves are false:
  - BudgetAssertion is parsed at fixture_metadata.rs:273 and read only by
    participates_in_matrix() (fixture_metadata.rs:37). Nothing compares it to a
    measurement.
  - fz2 has no dump command: './target/debug/fz2 dump' => 'unknown command'.
  - DUMP_BUDGET_TOLERANCE_PERCENT does not exist anywhere in the tree.

Either wire it up or delete it. It currently misleads exactly the way the project
rules warn about, and fz-5xp must not plan to pin new stdlib work with budget.*.

Related: no gate exists on runtime-library spec population either --
assert.metric.semantic.* in fixtures 00547-00552 counts only executables whose
function comes from the fixture's own code (fixture_contract_harness_test.rs:128).
Expanding the stdlib without such a gate means specialization growth lands unmeasured.
title: budget.* fixture frontmatter is parsed but never checked
